## Why it matters

Managed by the National Library of Australia, Trove is an invaluable public portal containing hundreds of millions of digitized historical newspapers, manuscripts, maps, diaries, and photographs.

It is a vital resource for study of Oceania, Australia, and British colonial history, enabling researchers to perform large-scale text mining of historical press and research settler-indigenous relations.
